This endpoint performs a spatial lookup against the administrative_boundaries table

post.description:
Creates a task at the given coordinates. Charges 1–3 Silver Seals upfront.
The response includes `verification_code` which is shown ONLY to the creator
and must be shared with helpers out-of-band (via chat) to verify completion.
A 7-day cooldown applies between task creations per user.

get.description: Returns tasks that the worker has applied to.
Returns all tasks where the caller is the creator.
Returns open tasks within a given radius (metres) of the provided coordinates.
Returns the details of a single task.

delete.description:
Cancels an open task and refunds the Silver Seal charge to the creator.
Only allowed while no worker has been confirmed yet (workers_filled == 0).

409.description: Task already completed or cancelled, or has active workers

get.description:
Returns all applications for the given task.
Only the task creator can call this endpoint.
get.summary: List applicants for a task (creator only)

get.description: Returns a single application. Accessible by the task creator or the applicant.
get.summary: Get a single application by ID

delete.description: Executor withdraws/cancels their pending or accepted application, removing it from the task.

post.description: Marks an application as accepted, allowing the helper to proceed.

User1 presses "Yes, this person helped me" in the confirmation popup.
The application must already be in `code_verified` status.
Triggers a Silver Seal transfer to the helper and increments `workers_filled`.
When `workers_filled` reaches `workers_needed` the task moves to `completed`.
post.summary: Confirm a helper completed the task (creator only)

post.description: Marks an application as rejected.

User2 enters the code they received from the creator in chat.
On success the application moves to `code_verified` status,
which enables the creator to confirm completion.

User2 applies to help with the given task. Creates a pending application
and opens a direct chat between the applicant and the creator.
post.summary: Apply to help with a task ("I can help")

400.description: Cannot apply to your own task

409.description: Already applied | Task full | Task not open

duration.description: e.g. "24h", "7d". Required if BanType is temporary

rank.description:
Rank is the full human-readable tier string (e.g. "Moonstone | Intention | S").
Computed at read time from ReputationScore so it never goes stale when
rank thresholds change. See [feed.fillAuthorRank].

rank_sub_level.description: RankSubLevel is the sub-level label within the rank tier (e.g. "Intention")

reputation_score.description:
ReputationScore is the lifetime count of Gold Seals the author has
*received* (whole seals). This is the single input that drives Rank —
FE can re-derive the rank locally if it ever needs to.

accumulated_break_seconds.description:
AccumulatedBreakSeconds exposes how many off-feed seconds have been served so far.
Client can use this to animate the break countdown even between sync calls.

duration_seconds.description: DurationSeconds is required for video attachments. Feed rejects videos longer than MaxVideoDurationSeconds.

is_own_post.description: IsOwnPost lets the client show/hide the ··· edit/delete options menu

viewer_has_liked.description: ViewerHasLiked lets the client render the ❤️ heart as filled immediately

visibility.description: Visibility is returned so the client can show the globe 🌐 or allies 👥 icon
